verdict.rationale: Vanta's Manage Vanta API/Vanta API is well documented for pushing custom resources and user accounts from homegrown/uncatalogued systems and converting them into pass/fail Custom Tests, plus bulk document/evidence upload, webhooks, and SDKs — directly matching the developer story. missing for 10: no publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s on probe) and no independent/hands-on developer account corroborating real-world custom integration builds.
